pairs.subject: connector-catalog
pairs.evidence: src/lib/credentials/connectorLicensing.ts:180 Licensing tier is decided first by a hand-maintained side table that overrides the row's own metadata.pricing_tier; measured against scripts/connectors/builtin/*.json, 6 connectors disagree (asana enterprise vs row freemium, calendly paid vs row free, ramp personal vs row paid, granola, leonardo_ai, hubspot), so the taxonomy axis has two authorities and the side table silently wins.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/credentials/connectorLicensing.ts:180 Rows themselves are data (builtinConnectors.ts:32 globs every seed JSON, and connectorCategoryTags unions scalar+list as prescribed), and audiences use the documented row-first/fallback union bridge (though 0 of 135 seeds carry metadata.audiences yet). But licensing inverts the bridge (side table beats row, 6 measured disagreements), and CONNECTOR_ROLES (connectorRoles.ts:72) is a pure side table with no row read: 37 of its members (mailchimp, openai, shopify, zendesk, ...) name no shipped seed. The in-context seed test (builtinConnectors.test.ts:83) checks only key presence, never that roles fall in the closed set or that the probe references declared fields.
